probe: X1: does a github marketplace declared in committed project settings load the plugin headlessly?
method: Two scratch projects under the scratchpad, each with only .claude/settings.json: extraKnownMarketplaces.ko-quality with source github repo shk95/ko-quality, (a) without path, (b) with path dist/claude-code; enabledPlugins ko-quality@ko-quality. One headless run each (claude -p, --max-turns 1, stream-json). The init event's plugins, agents and skills were read.

results.no_path: not loaded: no ko-quality plugin, no korean-* agents, no ko-* skills

side_effects: None: the user's marketplace list, plugin directory and user settings were identical before and after.
verdict: A github marketplace in committed settings does not load headlessly. The per-machine marketplace step stays (L4, F13). Interactive trust remains untested.
